name: Last One Standing Academy
source:
Five hundred years remain before humanity reaches its new home planet. With resources running out, sacrifices are necessary. To control the population, the ship uses academics as a ruthless selection system. Students aged seven to eighteen are enrolled in the academy, cut off from all contact with the outside.

You play as a student in their final year at the last school remaining in the universe. One year of exams awaits. Pass them all and graduate… or fail and lose your right to live.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4450110/Last_One_Standing_Academy/?beta=0]Steam[/url]]
translation:
距离人类到达新家园还有五百年。随着资源的枯竭，牺牲是必要的。为了控制人口，这艘船使用学术作为无情的选拔系统。七岁至十八岁的学生就读于学院，与外界隔绝。

你扮演宇宙中最后一所学校的最后一年学生。一年的考试等待着。通过所有考试并毕业……或者失败并失去生存的权利。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4450110/Last_One_Standing_Academy/?beta=0]Steam[/url]]
